newsitem.title: GERMANY: German trade unions see Dec jobless up to 4.1 mln.
newsitem.headline: German trade unions see Dec jobless up to 4.1 mln.

text.p: Germany's DGB trade union federation said on Tuesday it expected unemployment to rise to 4.1 million in December before surging to a post-war record of between 4.5 and 4.6 million in February.
DGB deputy head Ursule Engelen-Kefer told reporters that national unemployment would average 4.1 million this year if no action was taken to create new jobs.
The DGB figures are not seasonally adjusted.
German trade unions see Dec jobless up to 4.1 million
Engelen-Kefer's comments carry weight because she sits on the board of Germany's Federal Labour Office, which administers unemployment benefits and calculates jobless data.

December's unemployment figures are due for publication on Thursday. Unadjusted unemployment rose to 3.94 million in November, while the seasonally adjusted figure rose by 50,000 to 4.1 million, previous data showed.

The German government, determined to meet borrowing targets specified by the Maastricht treaty to qualify for European monetary union, has based its financial plans on the assumption that unemployment would average under four million this year.
